Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Hermann Friedrich Graebe died first (1986) before Louis-René de Caradeuc de La Chalotais (1785). This is a fundamental chronological error: 1785 occurs long before 1986. The correct answer is that Louis-René de Caradeuc de La Chalotais died first. The Planner failed to perform a basic date comparison in its "Analysis of Previous Result" at Step 11, instead of recognizing that 1785 < 1986.
